project.name: TOSS
project.description: eFootball tournament platform — compete in tournaments, wager head-to-head battles, win M-Pesa payouts

architecture.pattern: Monorepo — client/ and server/ in one repo
architecture.routing: SPA client-side routing (no React Router), page state via useState<PageName>
architecture.auth: JWT in localStorage, Bearer token in API requests, Telegram OAuth via bot
architecture.api_proxy: Nginx on :443 proxies /api/* to server port 3001, serves client/dist as static

App.tsx.purpose: Root router — page state machine, header, bottom nav
App.tsx.layout: max-width 430px centered, sticky header with transparent bg, fixed bottom nav with FAB

Icons.tsx.pattern: Custom SVG icon components (not Phosphor yet — 30+ hand-drawn SVG paths)

sections: Hero carousel (auto-advance 6s, Ken Burns zoom, staggered text animation)
HomePage.tsx.data: Fetches real tournaments from API, derives heroes/trending/results/upcoming from list

features: Tournament cards with status dots, player count bars
Phone input for M-Pesa STK push
Accept modal with M-Pesa phone input

sections: Profile card (gradient bg, initials, level badge, verified)

features: Tap to mark read with visual dot indicator
Data from localStorage (seeded with welcome notifs)

compat.ts.description: API client for pages — direct fetch to /api/*

static.dist/: Built output — served by nginx or server.cjs

server.description: Express.js REST API + Socket.io + Telegram bot

config.package.json: Dependencies: express, better-sqlite3, jsonwebtoken, bcryptjs, multer, socket.io, node-telegram-bot-api, axios, cors, express-rate-limit

index.ts.description: Express server entry — routes, middleware, SPA fallback, error handler

tables: users (id, username, email, password, firstName, lastName, phone, isAdmin, isSuperAdmin, telegramId, telegramUsername, telegramPhotoUrl, avatarUrl, createdAt)

tournaments (id, name, description, platform, format, maxPlayers, bestOf, status, ownerId, winnerId, prizePool, registrationDeadline, rules, groupCount, bracketType, imageUrl, isPrivate, entryFee, accessToken, createdAt)
matches (id, tournamentId, round, matchNumber, player1Id, player2Id, player1Score, player2Score, winnerId, status, submittedAt, createdAt)
wagers (id, creatorId, challengerId, stakeAmount, commission, totalPot, status, winnerId, matchCode, expiresAt, createdAt)
notifications (id, userId, title, message, type, read, createdAt)

routes.tournamentRoutes.ts: GET /, GET /by-token/:token, POST /, PUT /:id, DELETE /:id, POST /:id/join, GET /:id/standings, GET /:id/participants
routes.wagerRoutes.ts: GET /, GET /my, POST /, POST /:id/accept, POST /:id/confirm, POST /:id/dispute
routes.deepLinkRoutes.ts: GET /:token — serves SPA with og:tags for Telegram preview

controllers.authController.ts: Login (JWT), register, getMe, updateProfile, telegramLogin (validate initData, issue JWT)
controllers.tournamentController.ts: CRUD, join (M-Pesa STK push for entry fee), standings, participants
controllers.matchController.ts: Submit result, confirm, get by tournament/user
controllers.wagerController.ts: Create, accept (M-Pesa charge), confirm winner (M-Pesa payout), dispute
controllers.adminController.ts: Stats (users count, tournaments, revenue, active wagers), user management, tournament management
controllers.telegramAuthController.ts: Validate Telegram initData HMAC, create/login user, issue JWT
controllers.deepLinkController.ts: getTournamentByToken (SEO meta tags), quickJoinByToken (phone + STK push)

services.mpesaService.ts: M-Pesa Daraja API — auth token, STK Push (C2B), query status, process result callback
services.bracketService.ts: Generate knockout/group brackets, advance winners, calculate standings
services.ocrService.ts: OCR proof validation for match screenshots (Tesseract or external API)
services.socketService.ts: Socket.io — real-time notifications, match updates, online status

bot.index.ts: Telegram bot via node-telegram-bot-api — /start with deep link, tournament browse, wager notifications

deployment.server.cjs: Node HTTP static server — serves client/dist, proxies /api/* + /tournament-images/ + /avatars/ to :3001

nginx.config: Reverse proxy at xtournament.duckdns.org — HTTPS termination, proxy_pass to :3001 for /api and /t, alias for static assets

environment.MPESA_*: Daraja API credentials (consumer key, secret, shortcode, passkey, callback URL)

shared_conventions.design_language: Dark gaming aesthetic, near-black + orange accent, Orbitron font for display, system-ui for body, 20px border-radius on cards, orange gradient FAB button
shared_conventions.layout: Mobile-first, max-width 430px centered, collapsible sidenav pattern, bottom tab bar with FAB
shared_conventions.api_pattern: All /api/* goes to server port 3001, JWT in Authorization header, JSON request/response
shared_conventions.state_pattern: Client-side useState routing (no React Router), localStorage for auth token + user, 1s polling for auth changes
